status: Design freeze before remaining 65 outcomes; proposal only, not execution authorization.
population: Remaining 65 unseen cases in the original 70-case manifest, excluding positions 7,29,40,58,70. No replacement, adaptive selection, or pilot pooling.
generation: 260 original frozen requests (65 x A/B/C/D); same Qwen revision, histories, writer instructions, temperature 0 and max_tokens 400. Any GPU execution requires new explicit authorization and an independently verified token/job budget. No inference in this audit.
primary_estimand: Paired writer marginal effect on Semantic Correctness normalized to 0..1, using the mean of two independent ordinal ratings per answer.
hypothesis: Evidence instruction improves the mean semantic score: ((B-A)+(D-C))/2 > 0. Two-sided 95% interval will still be reported; a positive estimate alone is not confirmation.
secondary: Writer marginal effect on normalized Evidence Faithfulness
Dialogue marginal effect and writer-by-dialogue interaction for both semantic metrics
Strict within-case ranking reversals against unchanged Character F1
Per-condition frequency of score 2, core contradictions and unsupported central claims
evaluation: Freeze per-case reference anchors for all 65 BEFORE generating or viewing their responses, by a curator who cannot access those responses; use rubric_v1 without outcome-adaptive edits. Two fresh-context blinded reviewers per answer, independently shuffled, condition and F1 hidden. Prefer different model families or trained humans, subject to separate authorization if paid. Preserve all original ratings. Primary mean-of-two, disagreements published; optional third blind adjudication only secondary.
statistics: Case is the independent unit. 10000 paired case bootstrap draws, seed 62026, percentile 95% interval for the primary mean contrast. Confirm positive effect only if lower endpoint > 0. Secondary estimates and intervals descriptive, no unadjusted confirmatory claims. Publish all predefined contrasts, ties and failures. No guaranteed power claimed for 65 cases.
missing: Report every inference/evaluation failure and denominator. For missing score pairs show complete-case descriptive results but withhold confirmatory conclusion until failures are resolved under a prospectively approved policy; never substitute pilot cases.
interpretation: Dialogue effects apply to these historically acquired histories with unequal acquisition costs; do not claim equal-compute search improvement. Single deterministic generation per cell does not estimate generation variance. Same-family judges share bias.
change_control: Hash this protocol and rubric before ratings; freeze future anchors and reviewer assignments before future outcomes. Any amendment is a new dated version with reason, made before outcomes, otherwise explicitly exploratory. Freeze is post-pilot, not pre-pilot preregistration.
cost: No new Qwen calls, GPU jobs or paid API calls authorized here. Future output ceiling 104000 tokens (260 x 400); input and job budget require existing tokenizer planner before authorization. Existing pilot tokens/cost unchanged. Reviewer work consumes Work usage.
